signature.name: South Bank Parklands
signature.detail: Brisbane's signature waterfront precinct, with a man-made beach, riverside walks and gardens, and it is the city's most famous sight. Go early in the morning or on a weekday to avoid the crowds, and bring swimwear if you want to use the free lagoon.

signature.name: Story Bridge
signature.detail: An iconic steel bridge over the Brisbane River and one of the city's defining landmarks. Walk or cycle across for free river views, or view it lit up at night from the nearby riverside paths.

signature.name: Brisbane City Hall
signature.detail: A grand heritage building in the heart of the city and a must-see for its architecture and central location. It is free to enter the public areas; check opening hours before you go and dress comfortably for the climb to the clock tower if available.

signature.name: Mount Coot-tha Lookout
signature.detail: The classic spot for panoramic views over Brisbane and beyond. Go around sunset for the best light, and note that public transport is limited, so a car or rideshare is the easiest way up.

signature.name: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary
signature.detail: A world-famous wildlife sanctuary and the top pick for seeing Australian animals up close. Book tickets online in advance and arrive early, as it is a short drive from the city centre.

signature.name: Queensland Art Gallery
signature.detail: A major free cultural attraction with strong Australian and international collections. Entry to the general collection is free; go on a weekday for a quieter visit.

signature.name: City Botanic Gardens
signature.detail: A peaceful riverside garden right by the city centre, ideal for an easy stroll. Visit in the cooler morning hours and combine it with a walk along the Brisbane River.

signature.name: Queen Street Mall
signature.detail: The city's central shopping and pedestrian hub, good for a quick taste of everyday Brisbane. It is busiest on weekends, so go on a weekday if you prefer space.

signature.name: Brisbane River
signature.detail: The river defines the city and links many of its best sights. A river walk or ferry ride is a cheap, scenic way to get around; go at dusk for the best views.

signature.name: Howard Smith Wharves
signature.detail: A revived riverside precinct under the Story Bridge, popular for walks and river views. It is liveliest in the evening; go earlier if you want a quieter stroll.

transport: Public transport around $3-5 a trip; taxis and rideshares moderate
